content:
Web content policy transactions are generally logged with log_type="Content Filtering" and log_component="Web Content
Policy" and appear in the "Web content policy" module of the Log viewer.
The transactions that appear in this Log have either been blocked or logged due to content that matches a content filter in the
corresponding rule. If the content has been scanned but doesn't match any content filter, it does not appear in this log and only appears
in the Web Filter Logs.
